name: Methylenedioxybenzylpiperazine
summary: MDBZP, also known as 1-(3,4-methylenedioxybenzyl)piperazine or as piperonylpiperazine, is a chemical compound of the benzylpiperazine family related to benzylpiperazine (BZP). MDBZP has been sold as a designer drug and has even been found as an ingredient in street Ecstasy pills.
